title: Crew Membership Query Request
description: POST /api/v1beta/projects/{project_id}/crews/memberships/query. Same read model as the GET, with the agent filter in the JSON body because agent ids are CONTENT and must never appear in a URL (traced as http.target/http.url). Page and per_page stay query parameters (not content). Read-only POST: never replayed from the idempotency store.

agent_ids.description: Agent filter (max 100 raw values, duplicates counted). CONTENT: never logged, never in a URL.
